div.div:
dunedaq v2.11.0.
Focus on trigger data structures and data selection algorithms, finalisation of TP receiver app (incl data/file format).
Preparatory work for unified queues/network API
hdf5libs release.
Support for extra commands. (anticipated from 3.0.0) in nanorc/appfwk.
Support in nanorc to launch special script for threads pinning, at start.
DQM platform in kubernetes in NP04!
SNB data flow fully defined on paper.
Spack.
Multi-build CC7 CCS8 (CCS9).
Card controller application added to initialise flx, monitor linkfs, ...

div.div:
Additional work "discovered" during developments:
1) introduce meaningful trigger type such that different inputs (e.g. HS) can be distinguished.
2) Revise what goes into GeoID and what goes into Fragment type; create definitions for detectors, types, etc in a central place, possibly outside the dataformat structures.
3) Define a coherent approach to data alignment/serialization.
